messages:
maya: Support reported a bunch of "oversize" embed requests: 413s with zero remediation. Customers confused. Can we give a lightweight hint so SDKs can split?
aj: We could return a stable advisory header on 413s, e.g. `X-Embed-Hint: dims=1024,bytes=512000,units_est=6,split_plan=4x256`. Advisory only, not a hard policy.

kevin: OK but Dedicated tenants require opt-in. Add a tenant flag `embed_hint_enabled` and never expose quota/billing numbers. Header must be estimates only.

maya: Console needs telemetry for this: `embed.hint.sent` and `embed.hint.used` so we can track adoption.

sara: Rollout plan: hosted canary 5% -> 20% -> full. Add dashboard card under Embeddings to show hint_sent vs hint_used and an ops alert if internal requests spike.

lucy: Runtime note: auto-splitting increases internal request count; include `estimated_split_requests` and `split_latency_est_ms` in the hint so SDKs can decide parallel vs serial.

aj: Proposed header shape: `X-Embed-Hint: dims=1024,bytes=512000,units_est=6,split=4x256,split_latency_est_ms=180`. Example response: `HTTP/1.1 413 ...
X-Embed-Hint: ...
{"error":"payload too large"}`

kevin: Add unit tests ensuring header suppressed for tenants with flag false. For Dedicated, require admin toggle and audit log.

maya: Console copy for support panel: "If you see Payload Too Large, try splitting vectors into ~N of size ~M or enable SDK auto-splitting." Keep it paste-ready.

sara: I'll create CON ticket and wire two alerts: adoption (hint_sent/requests>5% && hint_used<10% for 7d) and ops (splitter.calls > 4x baseline).

ops-bot: Watch metrics during canary: `ingest.queue_depth`, `ingest.shed_rate`, `ingest.e2e_ms`.

aj: I'll implement hosted hint header behind a feature flag and emit `embed.hint.sent`. SDK teams: add opt-in `auto_split_on_hint`.

kevin: SGTM. Include integration tests and ensure no PII leaks.

maya: Decision: implement advisory hint header for hosted canary, SDK opt-in, console telemetry and alerts, Dedicated admin opt-in only. I'll update KB when canary finishes. Closing.
